error.WORKER_ASSIGNMENT_NO_CANDIDATES: The task's work class declares no worker candidate list, so the system cannot choose a model for it. Name the model in the work input, or add a candidate list to the work class registry. No Run was created.
error.WORKER_ASSIGNMENT_NO_CANDIDATES.de: Task {taskId}: work class {workClass} declares no worker candidate list, so the system cannot choose a model for it. Name the model in the work input, or add a candidate list to the work class registry. No Run was created.
error.WORKER_ASSIGNMENT_NONE: No listed worker of the task's work class can run in this scope. No other model is chosen. Connect one of the listed models with /provider in deckent (or `deckent models connect --connection <connection> --model <model>`), then plan again; until then /do runs the task here in the terminal. No Run was created.
error.WORKER_ASSIGNMENT_NONE.detail: Task {taskId}: no listed worker of work class {workClass} can run in this scope ({skipped}). No other model is chosen. Connect one of the listed models with /provider in deckent (or `deckent models connect --connection <connection> --model <model>`), then plan again; until then /do runs the task here in the terminal. No Run was created.
error.WORKER_ASSIGNMENT_EXPANSION_LIMIT: A worker candidate list of the task's work class expands to more models than its bound allows, so no worker was chosen. Nothing is cut off silently. Narrow the list's selectors (tier, maker or channel) in the work class registry, then plan again. No Run was created.
Task {taskId}: the worker candidate list of work class {workClass} expands to more models than its bound allows, so no worker was chosen. Nothing is cut off silently. Narrow the list's selectors (tier, maker or channel) in the work class registry, then plan again. No Run was created.
error.WORKER_MODEL_UNASSIGNED: A task's work input names no model and the system has not assigned one at this step. Nothing ran. Plan again, or name the model in the work input.
error.BRAIN_ASSIGNMENT_REFUSED: The model plan names a worker model or reasoning effort. The system chooses workers from each task's work class, so the plan was refused. No proposal or Run was created; plan again.
error.WORK_CLASS_CANDIDATES_NOT_REGISTER: A work class names a worker candidate list that the work class registry does not declare. Correct the registry; no Run was created.

error.BRAIN_TIER_REFUSED: The Brain model {modelId} ({channelId}) may not plan work under the model tier/role registry. No other model was chosen; nothing was sent to the model and no proposal was created.
error.BRAIN_TIER_REFUSED.model-unknown: The Brain model {modelId} ({channelId}) is not in the model tier/role registry, so it may not plan work. No other model was chosen; nothing was sent to the model and no proposal was created. Choose a frontier Brain model with /model, or, as the installation owner at your own terminal: deckent models roles set --channel {channelId} --model {modelId} --tier frontier --roles brain (/roles shows the registry).
error.BRAIN_TIER_REFUSED.tier: The Brain model {modelId} ({channelId}) is a worker-tier model; only frontier-tier models plan work. No other model was chosen; nothing was sent to the model and no proposal was created. Choose a frontier Brain model with /model.
error.BRAIN_TIER_REFUSED.role-not-held: The Brain model {modelId} ({channelId}) is frontier-tier but the model tier/role registry does not give it the Brain role. No other model was chosen; nothing was sent to the model and no proposal was created. Choose a Brain model with /model.
error.BRAIN_TIER_REFUSED.exception-not-c: The interim Brain exception for {modelId} ({channelId}) is outside its declared dates, so the model may not plan work. No other model was chosen; nothing was sent to the model and no proposal was created. Choose a frontier Brain model with /model, or have the installation owner renew the dated exception.
error.BRAIN_TIER_REFUSED.exception-dropp: The interim Brain exception for {modelId} ({channelId}) has ended: a measured frontier Brain model is active in this scope. No other model was chosen; nothing was sent to the model and no proposal was created. Select that frontier model with /model.
error.BRAIN_TIER_REFUSED.role-unknown: The model tier/role registry declares no Brain role, so no model may plan work. Nothing was sent to a model and no proposal was created. Correct the registry.
error.MODEL_ROLE_NOT_REGISTERED: The model tier/role registry does not declare that role. Nothing was chosen; correct the registry or ask for a declared role.
error.MODEL_ROLE_OVERRIDE_DENIED: A model tier/role overlay changes a role, a model row or an exception that already exists without naming the version it replaces, or redefines a role. Nothing was changed; name the replaced version (compare-and-set) or use a new id.
error.MODEL_ROLE_TIER_INVALID: A model tier/role registry row gives a role to a model below that role's tier (a worker-tier model can never hold a frontier role). Nothing was changed; correct the row or declare a dated exception.
error.MODEL_ROLE_REGISTRY_LIMIT: The model tier/role registry exceeds its bounds (overlays, roles, rows or exceptions). Nothing was changed; reduce the registry.
error.MODEL_ROLE_REVISION_INVALID: The combined revision of the model tier/role registry and its overlays is too long to record. Nothing was changed; use shorter revisions or fewer overlays.
error.MODEL_ROLE_LAYER_INVALID: Model tier/role overlays belong to the installation (global) configuration; a project configuration cannot change which models may serve a role. Move the model_roles section to the global configuration.
assignment.config.modelRoles: Installation overlays of the model tier/role registry: which exact catalog models may serve the Brain, worker, recovery-decision and memory-evaluator roles, and dated exceptions. Global layer only.
error.MODEL_ROLE_CATALOG_UNKNOWN: That exact model is not in the model catalog this scope can see, so it cannot be given a tier or role. Nothing was changed; register the catalog that lists it (deckent models catalog register) and check the channel and model id with deckent models roles.
error.MODEL_ROLE_COMMAND_INVALID: The tier/role request is not valid (unknown tier, a role named twice, or a malformed model_roles section). Nothing was changed; check deckent models roles --help.
error.MODEL_ROLE_STALE: The model tier/role registry changed after the card was shown. Nothing was changed; run the command again to see the current state.
